environment.plugin_install: documented GitHub spec with the pnpm allowBuilds approval flow
environment.dsh_home: isolated temporary DSH_HOME; headless profile from the shipped template
environment.route: claude-code-session, model haiku or opus, reasoningEffort high
environment.transcript_log_note: The dsh profile sandbox denies the Claude CLI transcript write under the user home. The plugin request audit uses the official raw-body diagnostic instead.
environment.bash_tool_note: The dsh headless sandbox refuses the bash tool (SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE). The measured tool calls use dsh filesystem tools.

lead_measurements.note: The Lead measured the same two image items independently in an isolated headless profile before this record. The raw run outputs are read-only under .local/evidence/live-dsh-acceptance-2026-11-11/ (acc-image-out.jsonl, acc-subagent-out.jsonl, acc-think-out.jsonl).
lead_measurements.image_tool_result: read_image tool call, completed image/png 480x160 tool result, final answer PANGOLIN7
lead_measurements.subagent_image: subagent tool call started a subagent; the final answer was PANGOLIN7
lead_measurements.thinking_run: a complex opus prompt produced one thinking block with empty display text

checks.item: One user image reaches the model through dsh
checks.blocker: The headless app has no attachment input path: a task is text on the command line or stdin, so no user message can carry an image block. No dsh profile was given a user-image turn.

checks.item: One image tool result reaches the model through dsh
checks.method: dsh --profile headless --json with the task: use the read_image tool on word.png and reply with the word
checks.observed: tool_call read_image, tool_result completed with image/png 480x160 6637 bytes, final answer PANGOLIN7

checks.item: A subagent session receives and reads an image
checks.method: the same profile with the task: start a subagent that reads word.png with read_image and report the word
checks.observed: subagent tool call, subagent descriptor in the dsh session, final answer PANGOLIN7. The raw run is in the Lead artifacts for the 2131abc profile; an earlier delivery run in an isolated profile at commit f2dccce showed the same shape and answer.

checks.item: The next native request after a tool result retains the signed thinking block unchanged
checks.blocker: The first response produced a signed thinking block (signature present, 1048 characters in the delivery run; 912 in the Lead run). For the following request the plugin request audit stored retentionAudit 'unavailable' with the capture failure 'earlier message prefix differs'. An image tool-result continuation additionally fails with 'unsupported image content' because the merged capture does not compare image content. The plugin therefore cannot certify signature retention in-profile, and no independent raw request body is retained after close. This needs a request-capture fix (multi-message assistant grouping plus the continuation message shape).
The headless app exposes no maxTokens control on the task path, so a dsh turn cannot set GenerateOptions.maxTokens. The mapping is offline-tested only (row O39, decision D17).

checks.item: A many-image session offloads safely or fails with the documented code
checks.blocker: A dsh profile run with more than 80 retained images (or the dsh image-offload retry) was not run. The direct official-SDK probe sent 100 and 101 synthetic images and both succeeded, so the provider limit was not reached (many-image-probe-2026-11-11.json).

retention_audit_note: In the simple image runs the plugin stored retentionAudit 'accepted' for the request before the image tool result and 'unavailable' for the request after it. That is the honest, fail-closed behavior: no false audit claim.
proven: The plugin installs from the documented GitHub spec in an isolated headless profile and serves the Claude route.
A real dsh read_image tool-result image reaches the model through the plugin.
A subagent session receives and reads an image through the plugin.
The plugin reports retentionAudit 'accepted' for in-profile requests that pass its checks and 'unavailable' when a check fails.
not_proven: A user-image turn through dsh (no headless attachment input).
Signed-thinking retention after a tool result through the in-profile audit.
The live output-cap mapping through dsh.
A many-image dsh session, offload retry, or rollover.
